verdict.rationale: Expensify documents a REST-style Integration Server API with OAuth2 authorization code flow and scoped/short-lived access tokens, plus API credential generation (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret, client secret rotation), which supports pulling expense/report data programmatically. However, there's no explicit evidence of dedicated endpoints for pulling receipts specifically, no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the API's reliability or completeness, and no mention of rate limits, SDKs, or scope granularity beyond basic OAuth. missing for 10: independent developer corroboration, explicit receipt-pull endpoint documentation, detail on scope granularity/rate limits.
